task1.title: Goods transported in the UK by four modes of transport, 1974–2002
task1.prompt: The graph below shows the quantities of goods transported in the UK between 1974 and 2002 by four different modes of transport.

chartDesc.overview: Goods transported by Road and Shipping in land both showed substantial upward trends, with Shipping in land eventually surpassing Road to become the most used mode by 2002. Conversely, Rail transport saw a gradual decline over the period, while Ocean transport remained the lowest throughout.
keyFeatures: Road transport was initially the highest in 1974 at 77 million tonnes, rising to 108 million tonnes in 1998 before falling slightly to 106 million tonnes in 2002.
Shipping in land rose significantly from 70 million tonnes in 1974 to overtake Road between 1994 and 1998, peaking at 117 million tonnes in 2002.
Rail transport steadily dropped from 21 million tonnes in 1974 down to 12 million tonnes in 2002.
Ocean transport remained the lowest mode, slowly increasing from 5 million tonnes in 1974 to 8 million tonnes in 2002.

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
task1.sampleBand8:
The line graph shows how many million tonnes of goods were moved in the United Kingdom by four means of transport — road, water (shown as "shipping in land"), rail and ocean — at four-year intervals between 1974 and 2002.

Overall, road and inland waterways carried by far the most freight and both grew substantially, whereas rail declined steadily and ocean transport, though rising, remained marginal. By the end of the period, inland shipping had overtaken road to become the leading mode.

In 1974, road was the dominant means, transporting about 77 million tonnes, slightly ahead of inland shipping at 70. Both fluctuated only mildly until 1986, after which they climbed sharply. Road peaked at roughly 108 million tonnes in 1998 before easing back to 106 in 2002. Inland shipping rose even faster, drawing level with road around 1998 and finishing highest of all at approximately 117 million tonnes.

The other two modes carried far smaller quantities. Rail followed a gentle downward trend, slipping from 21 million tonnes in 1974 to just 12 by 2002. Ocean transport, meanwhile, was the smallest throughout, though it crept up gradually from about 5 to 8 million tonnes, ending only narrowly below rail. In short, the two heavyweight modes pulled further ahead while the minor ones converged at the bottom.
task1.uzSampleBand8:
Chiziqli grafik 1974–2002-yillarda to'rt yillik oraliqlarda Buyuk Britaniyada to'rt xil transport vositasi — avtomobil (road), ichki suv yo'llari ("shipping in land"), temir yo'l va okean — orqali qancha million tonna yuk tashilganini ko'rsatadi.

Umuman olganda, avtomobil va ichki suv yo'llari eng ko'p yuk tashigan va ikkalasi ham sezilarli o'sgan, temir yo'l esa barqaror pasaygan, okean transporti esa o'ssa-da, ahamiyatsiz darajada qolgan. Davr oxiriga kelib ichki suv tashuvi avtomobilni ortda qoldirib yetakchi turga aylandi.

1974-yilda avtomobil hukmron vosita bo'lib, taxminan 77 million tonna yuk tashigan — bu 70 milliondagi ichki suv tashuvidan bir oz oldinda. Ikkalasi 1986-yilgacha faqat yengil tebranib turdi, shundan so'ng keskin ko'tarildi. Avtomobil 1998-yilda taxminan 108 million tonna bilan cho'qqiga chiqib, 2002-yilda 106 ga biroz qaytib tushdi. Ichki suv tashuvi undan ham tezroq o'sib, 1998-yil atrofida avtomobil bilan tenglashdi va taxminan 117 million tonna bilan barchasidan yuqori yakunladi.

Qolgan ikki tur ancha kam miqdorda yuk tashidi. Temir yo'l ohista pasayish tendensiyasiga ergashib, 1974-yildagi 21 million tonnadan 2002-yilga kelib atigi 12 ga tushdi. Okean transporti esa boshdan-oxir eng kichigi bo'ldi, garchi u taxminan 5 dan 8 million tonnagacha asta-sekin sekin ko'tarilgan bo'lsa-da, temir yo'ldan atigi ozgina pastda yakunladi. Qisqasi, ikki og'ir vazn toifasidagi tur yanada oldinga chiqdi, kichiklari esa pastda bir-biriga yaqinlashdi.

task2.title: More freedom for children: positive or negative?
task2.prompt: In many parts of the world, children are given more freedom than in the past. Is this a positive or a negative development?
task2.instruction: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
task2.sampleBand8:
Children in many societies now enjoy far greater freedom than earlier generations did, from how they dress to how they spend their time. In my opinion this is broadly a positive change, provided that greater freedom is matched by appropriate guidance.

There are strong reasons to welcome this shift. Children who are allowed to make choices, question adults and pursue their own interests tend to grow into more independent, confident and creative adults. Freedom encourages self-expression and helps young people develop the decision-making skills they will need later, rather than simply obeying orders. A more open relationship with parents also means children are likelier to discuss their problems honestly, which can protect their emotional wellbeing. In an era of rapid change, this adaptability is a genuine advantage.

Nevertheless, freedom without limits carries real risks. Children lack the experience to judge every situation, so excessive freedom can expose them to danger — for instance unrestricted access to the Internet or a lack of routine around sleep and study. Too few boundaries may also leave them struggling to respect rules or cope with the word "no" later in life. The key, therefore, is balance: freedom should expand gradually as a child matures, always underpinned by clear guidance and reasonable limits.

In conclusion, I regard the trend towards greater freedom for children as largely positive, because it nurtures independence and self-confidence. It becomes negative only when parents mistake freedom for the absence of any guidance, so the ideal is freedom within sensible limits.
task2.uzSampleBand8:
Ko'plab jamiyatlarda bolalar endi avvalgi avlodlarga qaraganda ancha ko'proq erkinlikdan bahramand — kiyinishidan tortib vaqtini qanday o'tkazishigacha. Menimcha, bu umuman ijobiy o'zgarish, faqat kattaroq erkinlik munosib yo'l-yo'riq bilan uyg'unlashgan bo'lsa.

Bu o'zgarishni olqishlash uchun kuchli sabablar bor. Tanlov qilishga, kattalarga savol berishga va o'z qiziqishlarini quvishga ruxsat berilgan bolalar ko'proq mustaqil, ishonchli va ijodkor kattalar bo'lib ulg'ayadi. Erkinlik o'zini ifoda etishni rag'batlantiradi va yoshlarga shunchaki buyruqqa bo'ysunish o'rniga kelajakda kerak bo'ladigan qaror qabul qilish ko'nikmalarini rivojlantirishga yordam beradi. Ota-onalar bilan ochiqroq munosabat, shuningdek, bolalarning muammolarini samimiy muhokama qilish ehtimolini oshiradi, bu esa ularning hissiy salomatligini himoya qiladi. Tez o'zgaruvchan davrda bu moslashuvchanlik chinakam ustunlikdir.

Shunga qaramay, chegarasiz erkinlik jiddiy xatarlarni o'zida saqlaydi. Bolalarda har bir vaziyatni baholash uchun tajriba yetishmaydi, shu bois haddan tashqari erkinlik ularni xavf ostiga qo'yishi mumkin — masalan, internetdan cheklovsiz foydalanish yoki uyqu va o'qishda tartibning yo'qligi. Chegaralar juda kam bo'lsa, ular keyinchalik qoidalarni hurmat qilishda yoki "yo'q" so'ziga chidashda qiynalishi mumkin. Shu sababli asosiy narsa — muvozanat: erkinlik bola ulg'aygani sari asta-sekin kengayishi, doimo aniq yo'l-yo'riq va oqilona chegaralarga tayangan holda bo'lishi kerak.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, men bolalarga ko'proq erkinlik berish tendensiyasini asosan ijobiy deb bilaman, chunki u mustaqillik va o'ziga ishonchni tarbiyalaydi. U faqat ota-onalar erkinlikni har qanday yo'l-yo'riqning yo'qligi deb tushunganda salbiyga aylanadi, shuning uchun ideal — oqilona chegaralar doirasidagi erkinlik.
